status: Root-approved bounded supervised calibration; exploratory, not preregistered
prior: four independent Uniform[0,1) transition rows and independent uniform initial pair; float64 PCG64 simulation
data_draw_order: p shape(N,4), starts integers shape(N), then M random(N) transition arrays
collision_words: w(r)=0 + 1^r + 00 + 1^(62-r) + 0; r=8,54 followed by their complements
boundary_words: w(31),w(32),complement w(31),complement w(32); indexing check only, not independent feature generalization
target: Q(w)=0.75 A(w)+0.125, derived from literal word counts; A=C/J iff J>0 and 512D>=J, otherwise first terminal bit
objective: 0.5 mean prior KL(Q||q) + 0.5 mean four-word collision KL(Q||q); gradients use equivalent CE

model.initialization: same original pilot RNG order a, W, v; W normal sd sqrt(2/41), v normal sd sqrt(2/33), b/c zero; a unused/frozen
model.matched_initialization: half-count W=half-normalized W divided rowwise by count_scale, other parameters identical; same function class at fixed M; Adam not invariant

optimization.batch_draw_order: at each step draw 64 prior indices then 64 collision indices, with replacement; freeze once and reuse across all nine fits

stop: Stop on failed correctness check or after nine fixed fits; no expansion, no rate/width/seed tuning
limits: Q supervision differs from original next-token/edit objective
Matched function class and initial predictions do not make Adam parameterization-invariant
Finite unsuccessful fitting cannot prove inability
